xs.$description: Non-dot Badge, size=xs. Increased from 5px to 6px (2026-08-16, at explicit direction), now equal to every other size, same as before this round. Paired with this size's own recomputed diameter (below) to keep a single wide character (e.g. '%', measured 11.99px at font-xs) still fitting within it: 2×6 + 11.99 = 23.99px.

sm.$description: Non-dot Badge, size=sm. Increased from 5px to 6px (2026-08-16, at explicit direction), now equal to every other size. 2×6 + 11.99 (widest measured character at font-xs) = 23.99px, under sm's recomputed 27px diameter (below).

md.$description: Non-dot Badge, size=md. Increased from 5px to 6px (2026-08-16, at explicit direction), now equal to every other size. 2×6 + 13.22 (widest measured character at font-sm) = 25.22px, under md's recomputed 29px diameter (below).

lg.$description: Non-dot Badge, size=lg. Increased from 5px to 6px (2026-08-16, at explicit direction), now equal to every other size. 2×6 + 13.22 (widest measured character at font-sm) = 25.22px, under lg's recomputed 30px diameter (below).

xl.$description: Non-dot Badge, size=xl. Increased from 5px to 6px (2026-08-16, at explicit direction), now equal to every other size. 2×6 + 15.67 (widest measured character at font-base) = 27.67px, under xl's recomputed 34px diameter (below).

xs.$description: Non-dot Badge diameter (height, and min-width for the circle-when-one-character/pill-when-more mechanism — see Badge.module.css's .size* rules), size=xs. Recomputed (2026-08-16, at explicit direction) alongside padding-inline.xs rising from 5px to 6px — the prior 23px diameter no longer had room for a wide character at the new padding (2×6+11.99=23.99 > 23, would have broken the circle shape). 25px restores real margin: 23.99px required, ~1.0px of margin under 25px — the same margin this exact size safely rendered a full circle at previously (this is a full reversion to the diameter used the last time padding-inline was 6px). Widest character measured directly in real Chrome rendering of Nunito 600, not estimated.

sm.$description: Non-dot Badge diameter, size=sm. Recomputed (2026-08-16) after padding-inline.sm rose from 5px to 6px. Required: 2×6 + 11.99 (widest measured character at font-xs) = 23.99px — identical requirement to xs, since both share the same padding-inline and font-size; sized two steps above xs (27 vs 25) purely to keep the two sizes visually distinct despite that shared requirement — otherwise sm would collide with xs's own newly-recomputed diameter. ~3.0px of margin under 27px.

md.$description: Non-dot Badge diameter, size=md. Recomputed (2026-08-16) after padding-inline.md rose from 5px to 6px. Required: 2×6 + 13.22 (widest measured character at font-sm) = 25.22px. Sized to stay strictly below lg's own (also recomputed) 30px diameter — and above sm's own new 27px — while clearing its own requirement with real margin (~3.8px).

lg.$description: Non-dot Badge diameter, size=lg. Recomputed (2026-08-16) after padding-inline.lg rose from 5px to 6px. 2×6 (this size's padding-inline) + 13.22 (widest measured character at font-sm) = 25.22px, ~4.8px of margin under 30px — kept above md's own new 29px to preserve the ladder's ordering.

xl.$description: Non-dot Badge diameter, size=xl. Recomputed (2026-08-16) after padding-inline.xl rose from 5px to 6px. 2×6 (this size's padding-inline) + 15.67 (widest measured character at font-base) = 27.67px, ~6.3px of margin under 34px — widened from the prior round's 31px so the top of the ladder keeps a proportional step above lg (30→34) rather than collapsing to a 1px gap the forced xs/sm/md bumps would otherwise have left.
